title: Roblox Bye
blurb: Squeaky farewell, twin to the Roblox hi, and just as unbothered by circumstance. This is the sound of leaving the server, the call, the conversation, delivered with identical unearned cheerfulness regardless of how any of it went. Rage quit? Bye. Won everything and refused to explain? Bye. Emotional damage inflicted, then departure? Bye. All exits are equal in Roblox, a genuinely healthy attitude for a platform populated mostly by nine-year-olds. Deploy it as the last word in any argument you have decided not to continue. Byeeee.
origin: The cheerful farewell from Roblox voice/chat culture.
